title: La Foto del Cumpleaños, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: foto-cosala (MAJESTIC): cocina grande de la casa de un hacendado en Cosalá, Sinaloa, de noche durante su fiesta de cumpleaños. Ropa de diario, sin uniformes. Caras comunes, no famosas; los dos se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.BENITO_QUIROGA: Mexican man, the powerful business partner of a rich rancher, 52 years old, light-brown skin, slicked-back dark hair greying at the sides, a thin trimmed goatee, small cold eyes, a charcoal-grey suit jacket over an open-collar black shirt, a gold signet ring, his hands empty.
chars.FABIAN_ROSAS: Mexican young man, hired helper of the catering for the party, 24 years old, brown skin, short curly black hair, clean-shaven, honest dark eyes, a plain white long-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled up and black trousers (everyday clothes, not a uniform), a smartphone in his shirt pocket, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_COCINACOSALA: Large old kitchen of a rancher's colonial house in Cosala, Sinaloa, at night during a party: yellow tiled walls, copper pots hanging, a long wooden work table with trays of glasses and plates of food, a big old stove, a doorway with warm light and blurred party lights beyond, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
